description:
Search SIIL clothing by keyword, category, or price range.

    Args:
        query: Search keywords (matches product name, SKU, description).
               A lone category word (swimwear, belts, underwear) browses that
               live slug instead of full-text. Examples: "swimwear", "belt black", "MB01720"
        category: Filter by English name or live Woo slug.
                  Aliases: swimwear=banoen, belts=cinturon-siil-en,
                  underwear=intimo-en, panties=panties, wraps=bandas-en,
                  lingerie=bodies-en, protector=siil-protector-en, accessories
        min_price: Minimum price in EUR (e.g. 30.0)
        max_price: Maximum price in EUR (e.g. 100.0)
        limit: Number of results (max 50, default 20)
name: search_products
